name: Ore no Are ga Shinsei Sugite Chouhou Sarerun Daga!?
original_name: 俺のアレが神聖過ぎて重宝されるんだが！？
source:
Office worker Daigo Igarashi rushed to the bathroom with a stomachache while he was on the road.
As I was nearing the limit, I opened the door of the men's room and took off my pants.

Daigo, who should have entered the bathroom, stands in a strange place with his lower body exposed.
He was summoned to another world.

There are only beautiful women... Or rather, a world where there are only women.
It seems that all the children born are "women" and once every ten years, they invite men from another world to leave offspring.
Daigo was chosen as the important partner.

However, Daigo was a real devil whose personality changed when it came to sex...
Is it really okay to leave this man to the big role of conceiving tens of millions of women?

Daigo's devilish conceiving life begins...!??

上班族五十岚大吾在路上因胃痛冲向厕所。忍耐到极限时，他打开男厕所的门，脱下裤子。

本应进入厕所的大吾，竟以下半身裸露的状态站在奇怪的地方。他被召唤到了异世界。

那里只有美丽女人……不如说，是一个只有女人的世界。似乎所有出生的孩子都是“女性”，每十年便从异世界邀请男人来留下后代。大吾被选为重要伴侣。
